pages.title: Ecstasy
pages.text: Ecstasy is blinding, full of dizzying heights and dripping with sweet honey. The force of your jumps here will be amplified and a running jump becomes a great leap, which can be a boon to exploration with the right equipment but quite dangerous for the unprepared.

Ecstasy is home to typhlotic bees called $(bold)buzzed$() which frenetically search for their next meal. Because of their immaterial diet, their senses are based on experience: they can only detect you in a radius equal to the number of XP levels you have (maxed out at 33).$(br2)Their bites drain not only Self but also levels. They will flee for a while after each successful bite.
